title: M/S M B L INFRASTRUCTURE LTD versus PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT GOVERNMENT OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
2025:UHC:6269
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/S) No. 93 of 2025
M/s M.B.L. Infrastructure Limited ...Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Others ...Respondents
Advocates : Ms. Anusuya Salwan, Advocate with Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia,
Advocate for the petitioner
Mr. K.N. Joshi, Deputy Advocate General for the State.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
1. Petitioner is a civil contractor. He was awarded a
contract of strengthening of Roads by State Public
Works Department. Later, a dispute arose between the
parties which was referred for arbitration in terms of
the clause contained in the agreement executed
between them.
2. The dispute was decided in favour of petitioner by
the Arbitrator. State Public Works Department
challenged the award by an application filed under
Section 34 of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996,
before Commercial Court, Dehradun. Petitioner filed an
application, seeking execution of award before
Commercial Court, Dehradun. The application under
Section 34 as well as the execution application filed
before Commercial Court, Dehradun were transferred
to Commercial Court, Haldwani, pursuant to an
administrative order passed by the High Court.
3. Upon transfer of the cases to Haldwani, petitioner
moved application, seeking direction to the State Public
1

Works Department to deposit the amount awarded by
the Arbitrator and also to release the same in his
favour. The Commercial Court, Haldwani declined to
pass order on the application on the ground that
Interim Relief Application filed by State Public Works
Department in Section 34 Application is still pending.
4. Aggrieved by the said order passed by Commercial
Court, Haldwani dated 04.09.2024, petitioner has
approached this Court by filing petition under Article
227 of the Constitution.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner has produced in
Court orders dated 02.07.2025, passed by Commercial
Court, Haldwani in Arbitration Case No. 28 of 2024
(Public Works Department Vs. M/s MBL Infrastructures
Limited) and Arbitration Execution Case No. 110 of
2024 (MBL Infrastructures Ltd. Vs. PWD, Govt. Of
Uttarakhand). Perusal of these orders reveal that both
the cases have been retransferred to Commercial
Court, Dehradun, on the ground that seat of arbitration
was Dehradun, therefore as per the law declared by
Hon'ble Apex Court, Commercial Court, Dehradun alone
has jurisdiction to decide the cases.
6. Since Commercial Court, Haldwani has observed
that it does not have the jurisdiction to decide the
aforesaid cases, therefore, order dated 04.09.2024
impugned in this petition, is liable to be ignored.
7. The writ petition is disposed of with request to
Commercial Court, Dehradun to consider the Interim
Relief Application filed by State Public Works

Department with its application under Section 34 of
Arbitration and Conciliation Act and also the application
filed by petitioner, seeking deposit of the amount in
terms of the award, within four weeks from date of
presentation of certified of this order.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
18.07.2025 Mahinder/
